security-advisories/list-global-advisori.label: List global security advisories
security-advisories/list-global-advisori.description: Lists all global security advisories that match the specified parameters. If no other parameters are defined, the request will return only GitHub-reviewed advisories that are not malware.

security-advisories/get-global-advisory.label: Get a global security advisory
security-advisories/get-global-advisory.description: Gets a global security advisory using its GitHub Security Advisory (GHSA) identifier.

apps/get-authenticated.label: Get the authenticated app
apps/get-authenticated.description: Returns the GitHub App associated with the authentication credentials used. To see how many app installations are associated with this GitHub App, see the installations_count in the response.

apps/create-from-manifest.label: Create a GitHub App from a manifest
apps/create-from-manifest.description: Use this endpoint to complete the handshake necessary when implementing the GitHub App Manifest flow.

apps/get-webhook-config-for-app.label: Get a webhook configuration for an app
apps/get-webhook-config-for-app.description: Returns the webhook configuration for a GitHub App. For more information about configuring a webhook for your app, see "Creating a GitHub App."

apps/update-webhook-config-for-app.label: Update a webhook configuration for an app
apps/update-webhook-config-for-app.description: Updates the webhook configuration for a GitHub App. For more information about configuring a webhook for your app, see "Creating a GitHub App."

apps/list-webhook-deliveries.label: List deliveries for an app webhook
apps/list-webhook-deliveries.description: Returns a list of webhook deliveries for the webhook configured for a GitHub App.

apps/get-webhook-delivery.label: Get a delivery for an app webhook
apps/get-webhook-delivery.description: Returns a delivery for the webhook configured for a GitHub App.

apps/redeliver-webhook-delivery.label: Redeliver a delivery for an app webhook
apps/redeliver-webhook-delivery.description: Redeliver a delivery for the webhook configured for a GitHub App.

apps/list-installation-requests-for-auth.label: List installation requests for the authenticated app
apps/list-installation-requests-for-auth.description: Lists all the pending installation requests for the authenticated GitHub App.

apps/list-installations.label: List installations for the authenticated app
apps/list-installations.description: You must use a JWT to access this endpoint.

apps/get-installation.label: Get an installation for the authenticated app
apps/get-installation.description: Enables an authenticated GitHub App to find an installation's information using the installation id.

apps/delete-installation.label: Delete an installation for the authenticated app
apps/delete-installation.description: Uninstalls a GitHub App on a user, organization, or business account. If you prefer to temporarily suspend an app's access to your account's resources, then we recommend the "Suspend an app installation" endpoint.

apps/create-installation-access-token.label: Create an installation access token for an app
apps/create-installation-access-token.description: Creates an installation access token that enables a GitHub App to make authenticated API requests for the app's installation on an organization or individual account.

apps/suspend-installation.label: Suspend an app installation
apps/suspend-installation.description: Suspends a GitHub App on a user, organization, or business account, which blocks the app from accessing the account's resources.

apps/unsuspend-installation.label: Unsuspend an app installation
apps/unsuspend-installation.description: Removes a GitHub App installation suspension.

apps/delete-authorization.label: Delete an app authorization
apps/delete-authorization.description: OAuth and GitHub application owners can revoke a grant for their application and a specific user.

apps/check-token.label: Check a token
apps/check-token.description: OAuth applications and GitHub applications with OAuth authorizations can use this API method for checking OAuth token validity without exceeding the normal rate limits for failed login attempts.

apps/delete-token.label: Delete an app token
apps/delete-token.description: OAuth or GitHub application owners can revoke a single token for an OAuth application or a GitHub application with an OAuth authorization.

apps/reset-token.label: Reset a token
apps/reset-token.description: OAuth applications and GitHub applications with OAuth authorizations can use this API method to reset a valid OAuth token without end-user involvement.

apps/scope-token.label: Create a scoped access token
apps/scope-token.description: Use a non-scoped user access token to create a repository scoped and/or permission scoped user access token. You can specify which repositories the token can access and which permissions are granted to the token.

apps/get-by-slug.label: Get an app
apps/get-by-slug.description: If the GitHub App you specify is public, you can access this endpoint without authenticating.

classroom/get-an-assignment.label: Get an assignment
classroom/get-an-assignment.description: Gets a GitHub Classroom assignment. Assignment will only be returned if the current user is an administrator of the GitHub Classroom for the assignment.

classroom/list-accepted-assigments-for-a.label: List accepted assignments for an assignment
classroom/list-accepted-assigments-for-a.description: Lists any assignment repositories that have been created by students accepting a GitHub Classroom assignment.

classroom/get-assignment-grades.label: Get assignment grades
classroom/get-assignment-grades.description: Gets grades for a GitHub Classroom assignment. Grades will only be returned if the current user is an administrator of the GitHub Classroom for the assignment.

classroom/list-classrooms.label: List classrooms
classroom/list-classrooms.description: Lists GitHub Classroom classrooms for the current user. Classrooms will only be returned if the current user is an administrator of one or more GitHub Classrooms.

classroom/get-a-classroom.label: Get a classroom
classroom/get-a-classroom.description: Gets a GitHub Classroom classroom for the current user. Classroom will only be returned if the current user is an administrator of the GitHub Classroom.

classroom/list-assignments-for-a-classro.label: List assignments for a classroom
classroom/list-assignments-for-a-classro.description: Lists GitHub Classroom assignments for a classroom. Assignments will only be returned if the current user is an administrator of the GitHub Classroom.

codes-of-conduct/get-all-codes-of-conduc.label: Get all codes of conduct
codes-of-conduct/get-all-codes-of-conduc.description: Returns array of all GitHub's codes of conduct.

codes-of-conduct/get-conduct-code.label: Get a code of conduct
codes-of-conduct/get-conduct-code.description: Returns information about the specified GitHub code of conduct.

emojis/get.label: Get emojis
emojis/get.description: Lists all the emojis available to use on GitHub.

dependabot/list-alerts-for-enterprise.label: List Dependabot alerts for an enterprise
dependabot/list-alerts-for-enterprise.description: Lists Dependabot alerts for repositories that are owned by the specified enterprise. To use this endpoint, you must be a member of the enterprise, and you must use an access token with the repo scope or security_events…

secret-scanning/list-alerts-for-enterpri.label: List secret scanning alerts for an enterprise
secret-scanning/list-alerts-for-enterpri.description: Lists secret scanning alerts for eligible repositories in an enterprise, from newest to oldest.

activity/list-public-events.label: List public events
activity/list-public-events.description: We delay the public events feed by five minutes, which means the most recent event returned by the public events API actually occurred at least five minutes ago.

activity/get-feeds.label: Get feeds
activity/get-feeds.description: GitHub provides several timeline resources in Atom) format. The Feeds API lists all the feeds available to the authenticated user:

gists/list.label: List gists for the authenticated user
gists/list.description: Lists the authenticated user's gists or if called anonymously, this endpoint returns all public gists:

gists/create.label: Create a gist
gists/create.description: Allows you to add a new gist with one or more files.

gists/list-public.label: List public gists
gists/list-public.description: List public gists sorted by most recently updated to least recently updated.

gists/list-starred.label: List starred gists
gists/list-starred.description: List the authenticated user's starred gists:

gists/update.label: Update a gist
gists/update.description: Allows you to update a gist's description and to update, delete, or rename gist files. Files from the previous version of the gist that aren't explicitly changed during an edit are unchanged.

gists/check-is-starred.label: Check if a gist is starred

gists/star.label: Star a gist
gists/star.description: Note that you'll need to set Content-Length to zero when calling out to this endpoint. For more information, see "HTTP verbs."

gitignore/get-all-templates.label: Get all gitignore templates
gitignore/get-all-templates.description: List all templates available to pass as an option when creating a repository.

gitignore/get-template.label: Get a gitignore template
gitignore/get-template.description: The API also allows fetching the source of a single template. Use the raw media type to get the raw contents.

apps/list-repos-accessible-to-installati.label: List repositories accessible to the app installation
apps/list-repos-accessible-to-installati.description: List repositories that an app installation can access.

apps/revoke-installation-access-token.label: Revoke an installation access token
apps/revoke-installation-access-token.description: Revokes the installation token you're using to authenticate as an installation and access this endpoint.

issues/list.label: List issues assigned to the authenticated user
issues/list.description: List issues assigned to the authenticated user across all visible repositories including owned repositories, member repositories, and organization repositories.

licenses/get-all-commonly-used.label: Get all commonly used licenses
licenses/get-all-commonly-used.description: Lists the most commonly used licenses on GitHub. For more information, see "Licensing a repository ."

licenses/get.label: Get a license
licenses/get.description: Gets information about a specific license. For more information, see "Licensing a repository ."

markdown/render-raw.label: Render a Markdown document in raw mode
markdown/render-raw.description: You must send Markdown as plain text (using a Content-Type header of text/plain or text/x-markdown) to this endpoint, rather than using JSON format.

apps/get-subscription-plan-for-account.label: Get a subscription plan for an account
apps/get-subscription-plan-for-account.description: Shows whether the user or organization account actively subscribes to a plan listed by the authenticated GitHub App.

apps/list-plans.label: List plans
apps/list-plans.description: Lists all plans that are part of your GitHub Marketplace listing.

apps/list-accounts-for-plan.label: List accounts for a plan
apps/list-accounts-for-plan.description: Returns user and organization accounts associated with the specified plan, including free plans. For per-seat pricing, you see the list of accounts that have purchased the plan, including the number of seats purchased.

apps/get-subscription-plan-for-account-s.label: Get a subscription plan for an account (stubbed)
apps/get-subscription-plan-for-account-s.description: Shows whether the user or organization account actively subscribes to a plan listed by the authenticated GitHub App.

apps/list-plans-stubbed.label: List plans (stubbed)
apps/list-plans-stubbed.description: Lists all plans that are part of your GitHub Marketplace listing.

apps/list-accounts-for-plan-stubbed.label: List accounts for a plan (stubbed)
apps/list-accounts-for-plan-stubbed.description: Returns repository and organization accounts associated with the specified plan, including free plans.

meta/get.label: Get GitHub meta information
meta/get.description: Returns meta information about GitHub, including a list of GitHub's IP addresses. For more information, see "About GitHub's IP addresses."

activity/list-public-events-for-repo-net.label: List public events for a network of repositories

activity/list-notifications-for-authenti.label: List notifications for the authenticated user
activity/list-notifications-for-authenti.description: List all notifications for the current user, sorted by most recently updated.

activity/mark-notifications-as-read.label: Mark notifications as read
activity/mark-notifications-as-read.description: Marks all notifications as "read" for the current user. If the number of notifications is too large to complete in one request, you will receive a 202 Accepted status and GitHub will run an asynchronous process to mark…

activity/get-thread.label: Get a thread
activity/get-thread.description: Gets information about a notification thread.

activity/mark-thread-as-read.label: Mark a thread as read
activity/mark-thread-as-read.description: Marks a thread as "read." Marking a thread as "read" is equivalent to clicking a notification in your notification inbox on GitHub:

activity/get-thread-subscription-for-aut.label: Get a thread subscription for the authenticated user
activity/get-thread-subscription-for-aut.description: This checks to see if the current user is subscribed to a thread. You can also get a repository subscription.

activity/set-thread-subscription.label: Set a thread subscription
activity/set-thread-subscription.description: If you are watching a repository, you receive notifications for all threads by default. Use this endpoint to ignore future notifications for threads until you comment on the thread or get an @mention.

activity/delete-thread-subscription.label: Delete a thread subscription
activity/delete-thread-subscription.description: Mutes all future notifications for a conversation until you comment on the thread or get an @mention. If you are watching the repository of the thread, you will still receive notifications.

meta/get-octocat.label: Get Octocat
meta/get-octocat.description: Get the octocat as ASCII art

orgs/list.label: List organizations
orgs/list.description: Lists all organizations, in the order that they were created on GitHub.

orgs/get.label: Get an organization
orgs/get.description: To see many of the organization response values, you need to be an authenticated organization owner with the admin:org scope.

orgs/delete.label: Delete an organization
orgs/delete.description: Deletes an organization and all its repositories.

orgs/update.label: Update an organization
orgs/update.description: Parameter Deprecation Notice: GitHub will replace and discontinue members_allowed_repository_creation_type in favor of more granular permissions.

actions/get-actions-cache-usage-for-org.label: Get GitHub Actions cache usage for an organization
actions/get-actions-cache-usage-for-org.description: Gets the total GitHub Actions cache usage for an organization. The data fetched using this API is refreshed approximately every 5 minutes, so values returned from this endpoint may take at least 5 minutes to get…

actions/get-actions-cache-usage-by-repo-.label: List repositories with GitHub Actions cache usage for an organization
actions/get-actions-cache-usage-by-repo-.description: Lists repositories and their GitHub Actions cache usage for an organization. The data fetched using this API is refreshed approximately every 5 minutes, so values returned from this endpoint may take at least 5 minutes…

oidc/get-oidc-custom-sub-template-for-or.label: Get the customization template for an OIDC subject claim for an organization
oidc/get-oidc-custom-sub-template-for-or.description: Gets the customization template for an OpenID Connect (OIDC) subject claim. You must authenticate using an access token with the read:org scope to use this endpoint.

oidc/update-oidc-custom-sub-template-for.label: Set the customization template for an OIDC subject claim for an organization
oidc/update-oidc-custom-sub-template-for.description: Creates or updates the customization template for an OpenID Connect (OIDC) subject claim. You must authenticate using an access token with the write:org scope to use this endpoint.

actions/get-github-actions-permissions-o.label: Get GitHub Actions permissions for an organization
actions/get-github-actions-permissions-o.description: Gets the GitHub Actions permissions policy for repositories and allowed actions and reusable workflows in an organization.

actions/set-github-actions-permissions-o.label: Set GitHub Actions permissions for an organization
actions/set-github-actions-permissions-o.description: Sets the GitHub Actions permissions policy for repositories and allowed actions and reusable workflows in an organization.

actions/list-selected-repositories-enabl.label: List selected repositories enabled for GitHub Actions in an organization
actions/list-selected-repositories-enabl.description: Lists the selected repositories that are enabled for GitHub Actions in an organization. To use this endpoint, the organization permission policy for enabled_repositories must be configured to selected.

actions/set-selected-repositories-enable.label: Set selected repositories enabled for GitHub Actions in an organization
actions/set-selected-repositories-enable.description: Replaces the list of selected repositories that are enabled for GitHub Actions in an organization. To use this endpoint, the organization permission policy for enabled_repositories must be configured to selected.

actions/enable-selected-repository-githu.label: Enable a selected repository for GitHub Actions in an organization
actions/enable-selected-repository-githu.description: Adds a repository to the list of selected repositories that are enabled for GitHub Actions in an organization.

actions/disable-selected-repository-gith.label: Disable a selected repository for GitHub Actions in an organization
actions/disable-selected-repository-gith.description: Removes a repository from the list of selected repositories that are enabled for GitHub Actions in an organization.

actions/get-allowed-actions-organization.label: Get allowed actions and reusable workflows for an organization
actions/get-allowed-actions-organization.description: Gets the selected actions and reusable workflows that are allowed in an organization. To use this endpoint, the organization permission policy for allowed_actions must be configured to selected.

actions/set-allowed-actions-organization.label: Set allowed actions and reusable workflows for an organization
actions/set-allowed-actions-organization.description: Sets the actions and reusable workflows that are allowed in an organization. To use this endpoint, the organization permission policy for allowed_actions must be configured to selected.

actions/get-github-actions-default-workf.label: Get default workflow permissions for an organization
actions/get-github-actions-default-workf.description: Gets the default workflow permissions granted to the GITHUB_TOKEN when running workflows in an organization, as well as whether GitHub Actions can submit approving pull request reviews.

actions/set-github-actions-default-workf.label: Set default workflow permissions for an organization
actions/set-github-actions-default-workf.description: Sets the default workflow permissions granted to the GITHUB_TOKEN when running workflows in an organization, and sets if GitHub Actions can submit approving pull request reviews.

actions/list-self-hosted-runners-for-org.label: List self-hosted runners for an organization
actions/list-self-hosted-runners-for-org.description: Lists all self-hosted runners configured in an organization.

actions/list-runner-applications-for-org.label: List runner applications for an organization
actions/list-runner-applications-for-org.description: Lists binaries for the runner application that you can download and run.

actions/generate-runner-jitconfig-for-or.label: Create configuration for a just-in-time runner for an organization
actions/generate-runner-jitconfig-for-or.description: Generates a configuration that can be passed to the runner application at startup.

actions/create-registration-token-for-or.label: Create a registration token for an organization
actions/create-registration-token-for-or.description: Returns a token that you can pass to the config script. The token expires after one hour.

actions/create-remove-token-for-org.label: Create a remove token for an organization
actions/create-remove-token-for-org.description: Returns a token that you can pass to the config script to remove a self-hosted runner from an organization. The token expires after one hour.

actions/get-self-hosted-runner-for-org.label: Get a self-hosted runner for an organization
actions/get-self-hosted-runner-for-org.description: Gets a specific self-hosted runner configured in an organization.

actions/delete-self-hosted-runner-from-o.label: Delete a self-hosted runner from an organization
actions/delete-self-hosted-runner-from-o.description: Forces the removal of a self-hosted runner from an organization. You can use this endpoint to completely remove the runner when the machine you were using no longer exists.

actions/list-labels-for-self-hosted-runn.label: List labels for a self-hosted runner for an organization
actions/list-labels-for-self-hosted-runn.description: Lists all labels for a self-hosted runner configured in an organization.

actions/set-custom-labels-for-self-hoste.label: Set custom labels for a self-hosted runner for an organization
actions/set-custom-labels-for-self-hoste.description: Remove all previous custom labels and set the new custom labels for a specific self-hosted runner configured in an organization.

actions/add-custom-labels-to-self-hosted.label: Add custom labels to a self-hosted runner for an organization
actions/add-custom-labels-to-self-hosted.description: Add custom labels to a self-hosted runner configured in an organization.

actions/remove-all-custom-labels-from-se.label: Remove all custom labels from a self-hosted runner for an organization
actions/remove-all-custom-labels-from-se.description: Remove all custom labels from a self-hosted runner configured in an organization. Returns the remaining read-only labels from the runner.

actions/remove-custom-label-from-self-ho.label: Remove a custom label from a self-hosted runner for an organization
actions/remove-custom-label-from-self-ho.description: Remove a custom label from a self-hosted runner configured in an organization. Returns the remaining labels from the runner.

actions/list-org-secrets.label: List organization secrets (Actions)
actions/list-org-secrets.description: Lists all secrets available in an organization without revealing their encrypted values.

actions/get-org-public-key.label: Get an organization public key (Actions)
actions/get-org-public-key.description: Gets your public key, which you need to encrypt secrets. You need to encrypt a secret before you can create or update secrets.

actions/get-org-secret.label: Get an organization secret (Actions)
actions/get-org-secret.description: Gets a single organization secret without revealing its encrypted value.

actions/create-or-update-org-secret.label: Create or update an organization secret (Actions)
actions/create-or-update-org-secret.description: Creates or updates an organization secret with an encrypted value. Encrypt your secret using LibSodium. For more information, see "Encrypting secrets for the REST API."

actions/delete-org-secret.label: Delete an organization secret (Actions)
actions/delete-org-secret.description: Deletes a secret in an organization using the secret name.

actions/list-selected-repos-for-org-secr.label: List selected repositories for an organization secret (Actions)
actions/list-selected-repos-for-org-secr.description: Lists all repositories that have been selected when the visibility for repository access to a secret is set to selected.

actions/set-selected-repos-for-org-secre.label: Set selected repositories for an organization secret (Actions)
actions/set-selected-repos-for-org-secre.description: Replaces all repositories for an organization secret when the visibility for repository access is set to selected. The visibility is set when you Create or update an organization secret.

actions/add-selected-repo-to-org-secret.label: Add selected repository to an organization secret (Actions)
actions/add-selected-repo-to-org-secret.description: Adds a repository to an organization secret when the visibility for repository access is set to selected. The visibility is set when you Create or update an organization secret.

actions/remove-selected-repo-from-org-se.label: Remove selected repository from an organization secret (Actions)
actions/remove-selected-repo-from-org-se.description: Removes a repository from an organization secret when the visibility for repository access is set to selected. The visibility is set when you Create or update an organization secret.

actions/list-org-variables.label: List organization variables
actions/list-org-variables.description: Lists all organization variables. You must authenticate using an access token with the admin:org scope to use this endpoint. If the repository is private, you must use an access token with the repo scope.

actions/create-org-variable.label: Create an organization variable
actions/create-org-variable.description: Creates an organization variable that you can reference in a GitHub Actions workflow.

actions/get-org-variable.label: Get an organization variable
actions/get-org-variable.description: Gets a specific variable in an organization.

actions/delete-org-variable.label: Delete an organization variable
actions/delete-org-variable.description: Deletes an organization variable using the variable name.

actions/update-org-variable.label: Update an organization variable
actions/update-org-variable.description: Updates an organization variable that you can reference in a GitHub Actions workflow.

actions/list-selected-repos-for-org-vari.label: List selected repositories for an organization variable
actions/list-selected-repos-for-org-vari.description: Lists all repositories that can access an organization variable that is available to selected repositories.

actions/set-selected-repos-for-org-varia.label: Set selected repositories for an organization variable
actions/set-selected-repos-for-org-varia.description: Replaces all repositories for an organization variable that is available to selected repositories. Organization variables that are available to selected repositories have their visibility field set to selected.

actions/add-selected-repo-to-org-variabl.label: Add selected repository to an organization variable
actions/add-selected-repo-to-org-variabl.description: Adds a repository to an organization variable that is available to selected repositories. Organization variables that are available to selected repositories have their visibility field set to selected.

actions/remove-selected-repo-from-org-va.label: Remove selected repository from an organization variable
actions/remove-selected-repo-from-org-va.description: Removes a repository from an organization variable that is available to selected repositories. Organization variables that are available to selected repositories have their visibility field set to selected.

orgs/list-blocked-users.label: List users blocked by an organization
orgs/list-blocked-users.description: List the users blocked by an organization.

orgs/check-blocked-user.label: Check if a user is blocked by an organization
orgs/check-blocked-user.description: Returns a 204 if the given user is blocked by the given organization. Returns a 404 if the organization is not blocking the user, or if the user account has been identified as spam by GitHub.

orgs/block-user.label: Block a user from an organization
orgs/block-user.description: Blocks the given user on behalf of the specified organization and returns a 204. If the organization cannot block the given user a 422 is returned.

orgs/unblock-user.label: Unblock a user from an organization
orgs/unblock-user.description: Unblocks the given user on behalf of the specified organization.

code-scanning/list-alerts-for-org.label: List code scanning alerts for an organization
code-scanning/list-alerts-for-org.description: Lists code scanning alerts for the default branch for all eligible repositories in an organization.

codespaces/list-in-organization.label: List codespaces for the organization
codespaces/list-in-organization.description: Lists the codespaces associated to a specified organization.

codespaces/set-codespaces-access.label: Manage access control for organization codespaces
codespaces/set-codespaces-access.description: Sets which users can access codespaces in an organization. This is synonymous with granting or revoking codespaces access permissions for users according to the visibility.

codespaces/set-codespaces-access-users.label: Add users to Codespaces access for an organization
codespaces/set-codespaces-access-users.description: Codespaces for the specified users will be billed to the organization.

codespaces/delete-codespaces-access-user.label: Remove users from Codespaces access for an organization
codespaces/delete-codespaces-access-user.description: Codespaces for the specified users will no longer be billed to the organization.

codespaces/list-org-secrets.label: List organization secrets (Codespaces)
codespaces/list-org-secrets.description: Lists all Codespaces secrets available at the organization-level without revealing their encrypted values. You must authenticate using an access token with the admin:org scope to use this endpoint.

codespaces/get-org-public-key.label: Get an organization public key (Codespaces)
codespaces/get-org-public-key.description: Gets a public key for an organization, which is required in order to encrypt secrets. You need to encrypt the value of a secret before you can create or update secrets.

codespaces/get-org-secret.label: Get an organization secret (Codespaces)
codespaces/get-org-secret.description: Gets an organization secret without revealing its encrypted value. You must authenticate using an access token with the admin:org scope to use this endpoint.

codespaces/create-or-update-org-secret.label: Create or update an organization secret (Codespaces)
codespaces/create-or-update-org-secret.description: Creates or updates an organization secret with an encrypted value. Encrypt your secret using LibSodium. For more information, see "Encrypting secrets for the REST API."

codespaces/delete-org-secret.label: Delete an organization secret (Codespaces)
codespaces/delete-org-secret.description: Deletes an organization secret using the secret name. You must authenticate using an access token with the admin:org scope to use this endpoint.

codespaces/list-selected-repos-for-org-s.label: List selected repositories for an organization secret (Codespaces)
codespaces/list-selected-repos-for-org-s.description: Lists all repositories that have been selected when the visibility for repository access to a secret is set to selected. You must authenticate using an access token with the admin:org scope to use this endpoint.

codespaces/set-selected-repos-for-org-se.label: Set selected repositories for an organization secret (Codespaces)
codespaces/set-selected-repos-for-org-se.description: Replaces all repositories for an organization secret when the visibility for repository access is set to selected. The visibility is set when you Create or update an organization secret.

codespaces/add-selected-repo-to-org-secr.label: Add selected repository to an organization secret (Codespaces)
codespaces/add-selected-repo-to-org-secr.description: Adds a repository to an organization secret when the visibility for repository access is set to selected. The visibility is set when you Create or update an organization secret.

codespaces/remove-selected-repo-from-org.label: Remove selected repository from an organization secret (Codespaces)
codespaces/remove-selected-repo-from-org.description: Removes a repository from an organization secret when the visibility for repository access is set to selected. The visibility is set when you Create or update an organization secret.

copilot/get-copilot-organization-details.label: Get Copilot for Business seat information and settings for an organization
copilot/get-copilot-organization-details.description: Gets information about an organization's Copilot for Business subscription, including seat breakdown and code matching policies. To configure these settings, go to your organization's settings on GitHub.com.

copilot/list-copilot-seats.label: List all Copilot for Business seat assignments for an organization
copilot/list-copilot-seats.description: Lists all Copilot for Business seat assignments for an organization that are currently being billed (either active or pending cancellation at the start of the next billing cycle).

copilot/add-copilot-for-business-seats-f.label: Add teams to the Copilot for Business subscription for an organization
copilot/add-copilot-for-business-seats-f.description: Purchases a GitHub Copilot for Business seat for all users within each specified team. The organization will be billed accordingly.

copilot/cancel-copilot-seat-assignment-f.label: Remove teams from the Copilot for Business subscription for an organization
copilot/cancel-copilot-seat-assignment-f.description: Cancels the Copilot for Business seat assignment for all members of each team specified. This will cause the members of the specified team(s) to lose access to GitHub Copilot at the end of the current billing cycle, and…

copilot/add-copilot-for-business-seats-f.label: Add users to the Copilot for Business subscription for an organization
copilot/add-copilot-for-business-seats-f.description: Purchases a GitHub Copilot for Business seat for each user specified. The organization will be billed accordingly.

copilot/cancel-copilot-seat-assignment-f.label: Remove users from the Copilot for Business subscription for an organization
copilot/cancel-copilot-seat-assignment-f.description: Cancels the Copilot for Business seat assignment for each user specified. This will cause the specified users to lose access to GitHub Copilot at the end of the current billing cycle, and the organization will not be…

dependabot/list-alerts-for-org.label: List Dependabot alerts for an organization
dependabot/list-alerts-for-org.description: Lists Dependabot alerts for an organization.

dependabot/list-org-secrets.label: List organization secrets (Dependabot)
dependabot/list-org-secrets.description: Lists all secrets available in an organization without revealing their encrypted values. You must authenticate using an access token with the admin:org scope to use this endpoint.

dependabot/get-org-public-key.label: Get an organization public key (Dependabot)
dependabot/get-org-public-key.description: Gets your public key, which you need to encrypt secrets. You need to encrypt a secret before you can create or update secrets. You must authenticate using an access token with the admin:org scope to use this endpoint.

dependabot/get-org-secret.label: Get an organization secret (Dependabot)
dependabot/get-org-secret.description: Gets a single organization secret without revealing its encrypted value. You must authenticate using an access token with the admin:org scope to use this endpoint.

dependabot/create-or-update-org-secret.label: Create or update an organization secret (Dependabot)
dependabot/create-or-update-org-secret.description: Creates or updates an organization secret with an encrypted value. Encrypt your secret using LibSodium. For more information, see "Encrypting secrets for the REST API."

dependabot/delete-org-secret.label: Delete an organization secret (Dependabot)
dependabot/delete-org-secret.description: Deletes a secret in an organization using the secret name. You must authenticate using an access token with the admin:org scope to use this endpoint.

dependabot/list-selected-repos-for-org-s.label: List selected repositories for an organization secret (Dependabot)
dependabot/list-selected-repos-for-org-s.description: Lists all repositories that have been selected when the visibility for repository access to a secret is set to selected. You must authenticate using an access token with the admin:org scope to use this endpoint.

dependabot/set-selected-repos-for-org-se.label: Set selected repositories for an organization secret (Dependabot)
dependabot/set-selected-repos-for-org-se.description: Replaces all repositories for an organization secret when the visibility for repository access is set to selected. The visibility is set when you Create or update an organization secret.

dependabot/add-selected-repo-to-org-secr.label: Add selected repository to an organization secret (Dependabot)
dependabot/add-selected-repo-to-org-secr.description: Adds a repository to an organization secret when the visibility for repository access is set to selected. The visibility is set when you Create or update an organization secret.

dependabot/remove-selected-repo-from-org.label: Remove selected repository from an organization secret (Dependabot)
dependabot/remove-selected-repo-from-org.description: Removes a repository from an organization secret when the visibility for repository access is set to selected. The visibility is set when you Create or update an organization secret.

packages/list-docker-migration-conflicti.label: Get list of conflicting packages during Docker migration for organization
packages/list-docker-migration-conflicti.description: Lists all packages that are in a specific organization, are readable by the requesting user, and that encountered a conflict during a Docker migration.

orgs/list-failed-invitations.label: List failed organization invitations
orgs/list-failed-invitations.description: The return hash contains failed_at and failed_reason fields which represent the time at which the invitation failed and the reason for the failure.

orgs/create-webhook.label: Create an organization webhook
orgs/create-webhook.description: Here's how you can create a hook that posts payloads in JSON format:

orgs/get-webhook.label: Get an organization webhook
orgs/get-webhook.description: Returns a webhook configured in an organization. To get only the webhook config properties, see "Get a webhook configuration for an organization."

orgs/update-webhook.label: Update an organization webhook
orgs/update-webhook.description: Updates a webhook configured in an organization. When you update a webhook, the secret will be overwritten.

orgs/get-webhook-config-for-org.label: Get a webhook configuration for an organization
orgs/get-webhook-config-for-org.description: Returns the webhook configuration for an organization. To get more information about the webhook, including the active state and events, use "Get an organization webhook ."

orgs/update-webhook-config-for-org.label: Update a webhook configuration for an organization
orgs/update-webhook-config-for-org.description: Updates the webhook configuration for an organization. To update more information about the webhook, including the active state and events, use "Update an organization webhook ."

orgs/list-webhook-deliveries.label: List deliveries for an organization webhook
orgs/list-webhook-deliveries.description: Returns a list of webhook deliveries for a webhook configured in an organization.

orgs/get-webhook-delivery.label: Get a webhook delivery for an organization webhook
orgs/get-webhook-delivery.description: Returns a delivery for a webhook configured in an organization.

orgs/redeliver-webhook-delivery.label: Redeliver a delivery for an organization webhook
orgs/redeliver-webhook-delivery.description: Redeliver a delivery for a webhook configured in an organization.

orgs/ping-webhook.label: Ping an organization webhook
orgs/ping-webhook.description: This will trigger a ping event to be sent to the hook.

apps/get-org-installation.label: Get an organization installation for the authenticated app
apps/get-org-installation.description: Enables an authenticated GitHub App to find the organization's installation information.

orgs/list-app-installations.label: List app installations for an organization
orgs/list-app-installations.description: Lists all GitHub Apps in an organization. The installation count includes all GitHub Apps installed on repositories in the organization. You must be an organization owner with admin:read scope to use this endpoint.

interactions/get-restrictions-for-org.label: Get interaction restrictions for an organization
interactions/get-restrictions-for-org.description: Shows which type of GitHub user can interact with this organization and when the restriction expires. If there is no restrictions, you will see an empty response.

interactions/set-restrictions-for-org.label: Set interaction restrictions for an organization
interactions/set-restrictions-for-org.description: Temporarily restricts interactions to a certain type of GitHub user in any public repository in the given organization. You must be an organization owner to set these restrictions.

interactions/remove-restrictions-for-org.label: Remove interaction restrictions for an organization
interactions/remove-restrictions-for-org.description: Removes all interaction restrictions from public repositories in the given organization. You must be an organization owner to remove restrictions.

orgs/list-pending-invitations.label: List pending organization invitations
orgs/list-pending-invitations.description: The return hash contains a role field which refers to the Organization Invitation role and will be one of the following values: direct_member, admin, billing_manager, or hiring_manager.

orgs/create-invitation.label: Create an organization invitation
orgs/create-invitation.description: Invite people to an organization by using their GitHub user ID or their email address. In order to create invitations in an organization, the authenticated user must be an organization owner.

orgs/cancel-invitation.label: Cancel an organization invitation
orgs/cancel-invitation.description: Cancel an organization invitation. In order to cancel an organization invitation, the authenticated user must be an organization owner.

orgs/list-invitation-teams.label: List organization invitation teams
orgs/list-invitation-teams.description: List all teams associated with an invitation. In order to see invitations in an organization, the authenticated user must be an organization owner.

issues/list-for-org.label: List organization issues assigned to the authenticated user
issues/list-for-org.description: List issues in an organization assigned to the authenticated user.

orgs/list-members.label: List organization members
orgs/list-members.description: List all users who are members of an organization. If the authenticated user is also a member of this organization then both concealed and public members will be returned.

orgs/check-membership-for-user.label: Check organization membership for a user
orgs/check-membership-for-user.description: Check if a user is, publicly or privately, a member of the organization.

orgs/remove-member.label: Remove an organization member
orgs/remove-member.description: Removing a user from this list will remove them from all teams and they will no longer have any access to the organization's repositories.

codespaces/get-codespaces-for-user-in-or.label: List codespaces for a user in organization
codespaces/get-codespaces-for-user-in-or.description: Lists the codespaces that a member of an organization has for repositories in that organization.

codespaces/delete-from-organization.label: Delete a codespace from the organization

codespaces/stop-in-organization.label: Stop a codespace for an organization user

copilot/get-copilot-seat-details-for-use.label: Get Copilot for Business seat assignment details for a user
copilot/get-copilot-seat-details-for-use.description: Gets the GitHub Copilot for Business seat assignment details for a member of an organization who currently has access to GitHub Copilot.

orgs/get-membership-for-user.label: Get organization membership for a user
orgs/get-membership-for-user.description: In order to get a user's membership with an organization, the authenticated user must be an organization member. The state parameter in the response can be used to identify the user's membership status.

orgs/set-membership-for-user.label: Set organization membership for a user
orgs/set-membership-for-user.description: Only authenticated organization owners can add a member to the organization or update the member's role.

orgs/remove-membership-for-user.label: Remove organization membership for a user
orgs/remove-membership-for-user.description: In order to remove a user's membership with an organization, the authenticated user must be an organization owner.

migrations/list-for-org.label: List organization migrations
migrations/list-for-org.description: Lists the most recent migrations, including both exports (which can be started through the REST API) and imports (which cannot be started using the REST API).

migrations/start-for-org.label: Start an organization migration
migrations/start-for-org.description: Initiates the generation of a migration archive.

migrations/get-status-for-org.label: Get an organization migration status
migrations/get-status-for-org.description: Fetches the status of a migration.

migrations/download-archive-for-org.label: Download an organization migration archive
migrations/download-archive-for-org.description: Fetches the URL to a migration archive.

migrations/delete-archive-for-org.label: Delete an organization migration archive
migrations/delete-archive-for-org.description: Deletes a previous migration archive. Migration archives are automatically deleted after seven days.

migrations/unlock-repo-for-org.label: Unlock an organization repository
migrations/unlock-repo-for-org.description: Unlocks a repository that was locked for migration. You should unlock each migrated repository and delete them when the migration is complete and you no longer need the source data.

migrations/list-repos-for-org.label: List repositories in an organization migration
migrations/list-repos-for-org.description: List all the repositories for this organization migration.

orgs/list-outside-collaborators.label: List outside collaborators for an organization
orgs/list-outside-collaborators.description: List all users who are outside collaborators of an organization.

orgs/convert-member-to-outside-collabora.label: Convert an organization member to outside collaborator
orgs/convert-member-to-outside-collabora.description: When an organization member is converted to an outside collaborator, they'll only have access to the repositories that their current team membership allows. The user will no longer be a member of the organization.

orgs/remove-outside-collaborator.label: Remove outside collaborator from an organization
orgs/remove-outside-collaborator.description: Removing a user from this list will remove them from all the organization's repositories.

packages/list-packages-for-organization.label: List packages for an organization
packages/list-packages-for-organization.description: Lists packages in an organization readable by the user.

packages/get-package-for-organization.label: Get a package for an organization
packages/get-package-for-organization.description: Gets a specific package in an organization.

packages/delete-package-for-org.label: Delete a package for an organization
packages/delete-package-for-org.description: Deletes an entire package in an organization. You cannot delete a public package if any version of the package has more than 5,000 downloads. In this scenario, contact GitHub support for further assistance.

packages/restore-package-for-org.label: Restore a package for an organization
packages/restore-package-for-org.description: Restores an entire package in an organization.

packages/get-all-package-versions-for-pa.label: List package versions for a package owned by an organization
packages/get-all-package-versions-for-pa.description: Lists package versions for a package owned by an organization.

packages/get-package-version-for-organiz.label: Get a package version for an organization
packages/get-package-version-for-organiz.description: Gets a specific package version in an organization.

packages/delete-package-version-for-org.label: Delete package version for an organization
packages/delete-package-version-for-org.description: Deletes a specific package version in an organization. If the package is public and the package version has more than 5,000 downloads, you cannot delete the package version.

packages/restore-package-version-for-org.label: Restore package version for an organization
packages/restore-package-version-for-org.description: Restores a specific package version in an organization.

orgs/list-pat-grant-requests.label: List requests to access organization resources with fine-grained personal access tokens
orgs/list-pat-grant-requests.description: Lists requests from organization members to access organization resources with a fine-grained personal access token.

orgs/review-pat-grant-requests-in-bulk.label: Review requests to access organization resources with fine-grained personal access tokens
orgs/review-pat-grant-requests-in-bulk.description: Approves or denies multiple pending requests to access organization resources via a fine-grained personal access token.

orgs/review-pat-grant-request.label: Review a request to access organization resources with a fine-grained personal access token
orgs/review-pat-grant-request.description: Approves or denies a pending request to access organization resources via a fine-grained personal access token. Only GitHub Apps can call this API, using the organization_personal_access_token_requests: write permission.

orgs/list-pat-grant-request-repositories.label: List repositories requested to be accessed by a fine-grained personal access token
orgs/list-pat-grant-request-repositories.description: Lists the repositories a fine-grained personal access token request is requesting access to. Only GitHub Apps can call this API, using the organization_personal_access_token_requests: read permission.

orgs/list-pat-grants.label: List fine-grained personal access tokens with access to organization resources
orgs/list-pat-grants.description: Lists approved fine-grained personal access tokens owned by organization members that can access organization resources. Only GitHub Apps can call this API, using the organization_personal_access_tokens: read permission.

orgs/update-pat-accesses.label: Update the access to organization resources via fine-grained personal access tokens
orgs/update-pat-accesses.description: Updates the access organization members have to organization resources via fine-grained personal access tokens. Limited to revoking a token's existing access.

orgs/update-pat-access.label: Update the access a fine-grained personal access token has to organization resources
orgs/update-pat-access.description: Updates the access an organization member has to organization resources via a fine-grained personal access token. Limited to revoking the token's existing access. Limited to revoking a token's existing access.

orgs/list-pat-grant-repositories.label: List repositories a fine-grained personal access token has access to
orgs/list-pat-grant-repositories.description: Lists the repositories a fine-grained personal access token has access to. Only GitHub Apps can call this API, using the organization_personal_access_tokens: read permission.

orgs/list-public-members.label: List public organization members
orgs/list-public-members.description: Members of an organization can choose to have their membership publicized or not.

orgs/check-public-membership-for-user.label: Check public organization membership for a user
orgs/check-public-membership-for-user.description: Check if the provided user is a public member of the organization.

orgs/set-public-membership-for-authentic.label: Set public organization membership for the authenticated user
orgs/set-public-membership-for-authentic.description: The user can publicize their own membership. (A user cannot publicize the membership for another user.)

orgs/remove-public-membership-for-authen.label: Remove public organization membership for the authenticated user
orgs/remove-public-membership-for-authen.description: Removes the public membership for the authenticated user from the specified organization, unless public visibility is enforced by default.

repos/list-for-org.label: List organization repositories
repos/list-for-org.description: Lists repositories for the specified organization.
repos/list-for-org.hint: Lists repositories belonging to an organization. For a personal account use 'List repositories for a user' or 'List repositories for the authenticated user'.

repos/create-in-org.label: Create an organization repository
repos/create-in-org.description: Creates a new repository in the specified organization. The authenticated user must be a member of the organization.

repos/get-org-rulesets.label: Get all organization repository rulesets
repos/get-org-rulesets.description: Get all the repository rulesets for an organization.

repos/create-org-ruleset.label: Create an organization repository ruleset
repos/create-org-ruleset.description: Create a repository ruleset for an organization.

repos/get-org-rule-suites.label: List organization rule suites
repos/get-org-rule-suites.description: Lists suites of rule evaluations at the organization level. For more information, see "Managing rulesets for repositories in your organization."

repos/get-org-rule-suite.label: Get an organization rule suite
repos/get-org-rule-suite.description: Gets information about a suite of rule evaluations from within an organization. For more information, see "Managing rulesets for repositories in your organization."

repos/get-org-ruleset.label: Get an organization repository ruleset
repos/get-org-ruleset.description: Get a repository ruleset for an organization.

repos/update-org-ruleset.label: Update an organization repository ruleset
repos/update-org-ruleset.description: Update a ruleset for an organization.

repos/delete-org-ruleset.label: Delete an organization repository ruleset
repos/delete-org-ruleset.description: Delete a ruleset for an organization.

secret-scanning/list-alerts-for-org.label: List secret scanning alerts for an organization
secret-scanning/list-alerts-for-org.description: Lists secret scanning alerts for eligible repositories in an organization, from newest to oldest.

security-advisories/list-org-repository-.label: List repository security advisories for an organization
security-advisories/list-org-repository-.description: Lists repository security advisories for an organization.

orgs/list-security-manager-teams.label: List security manager teams
orgs/list-security-manager-teams.description: Lists teams that are security managers for an organization. For more information, see "Managing security managers in your organization."

orgs/add-security-manager-team.label: Add a security manager team
orgs/add-security-manager-team.description: Adds a team as a security manager for an organization. For more information, see "Managing security for an organization for an organization."

orgs/remove-security-manager-team.label: Remove a security manager team
orgs/remove-security-manager-team.description: Removes the security manager role from a team for an organization. For more information, see "Managing security managers in your organization team from an organization."

billing/get-github-actions-billing-org.label: Get GitHub Actions billing for an organization
billing/get-github-actions-billing-org.description: Gets the summary of the free and paid GitHub Actions minutes used.

billing/get-github-packages-billing-org.label: Get GitHub Packages billing for an organization
billing/get-github-packages-billing-org.description: Gets the free and paid storage used for GitHub Packages in gigabytes.

billing/get-shared-storage-billing-org.label: Get shared storage billing for an organization
billing/get-shared-storage-billing-org.description: Gets the estimated paid and estimated total storage used for GitHub Actions and GitHub Packages.

teams/list.label: List teams (Teams)
teams/list.description: Lists all teams in an organization that are visible to the authenticated user.

teams/create.label: Create a team
teams/create.description: To create a team, the authenticated user must be a member or owner of {org}. By default, organization members can create teams. Organization owners can limit team creation to organization owners.

teams/get-by-name.label: Get a team by name
teams/get-by-name.description: Gets a team using the team's slug. To create the slug, GitHub replaces special characters in the name string, changes all words to lowercase, and replaces spaces with a - separator.

teams/delete-in-org.label: Delete a team
teams/delete-in-org.description: To delete a team, the authenticated user must be an organization owner or team maintainer.

teams/update-in-org.label: Update a team
teams/update-in-org.description: To edit a team, the authenticated user must either be an organization owner or a team maintainer.

teams/list-discussions-in-org.label: List discussions
teams/list-discussions-in-org.description: List all discussions on a team's page. OAuth access tokens require the read:discussion scope.

teams/create-discussion-in-org.label: Create a discussion
teams/create-discussion-in-org.description: Creates a new discussion post on a team's page. OAuth access tokens require the write:discussion scope.

teams/get-discussion-in-org.label: Get a discussion
teams/get-discussion-in-org.description: Get a specific discussion on a team's page. OAuth access tokens require the read:discussion scope.

teams/delete-discussion-in-org.label: Delete a discussion
teams/delete-discussion-in-org.description: Delete a discussion from a team's page. OAuth access tokens require the write:discussion scope.

teams/update-discussion-in-org.label: Update a discussion
teams/update-discussion-in-org.description: Edits the title and body text of a discussion post. Only the parameters you provide are updated. OAuth access tokens require the write:discussion scope.

teams/list-discussion-comments-in-org.label: List discussion comments
teams/list-discussion-comments-in-org.description: List all comments on a team discussion. OAuth access tokens require the read:discussion scope.

teams/create-discussion-comment-in-org.label: Create a discussion comment
teams/create-discussion-comment-in-org.description: Creates a new comment on a team discussion. OAuth access tokens require the write:discussion scope.

teams/get-discussion-comment-in-org.label: Get a discussion comment
teams/get-discussion-comment-in-org.description: Get a specific comment on a team discussion. OAuth access tokens require the read:discussion scope.

teams/delete-discussion-comment-in-org.label: Delete a discussion comment
teams/delete-discussion-comment-in-org.description: Deletes a comment on a team discussion. OAuth access tokens require the write:discussion scope.

teams/update-discussion-comment-in-org.label: Update a discussion comment
teams/update-discussion-comment-in-org.description: Edits the body text of a discussion comment. OAuth access tokens require the write:discussion scope.

reactions/list-for-team-discussion-comme.label: List reactions for a team discussion comment
reactions/list-for-team-discussion-comme.description: List the reactions to a team discussion comment. OAuth access tokens require the read:discussion scope.

reactions/create-for-team-discussion-com.label: Create reaction for a team discussion comment
reactions/create-for-team-discussion-com.description: Create a reaction to a team discussion comment. OAuth access tokens require the write:discussion scope. A response with an HTTP 200 status means that you already added the reaction type to this team discussion comment.

reactions/delete-for-team-discussion-com.label: Delete team discussion comment reaction
reactions/delete-for-team-discussion-com.description: Delete a reaction to a team discussion comment. OAuth access tokens require the write:discussion scope.

reactions/list-for-team-discussion-in-or.label: List reactions for a team discussion
reactions/list-for-team-discussion-in-or.description: List the reactions to a team discussion. OAuth access tokens require the read:discussion scope.

reactions/create-for-team-discussion-in-.label: Create reaction for a team discussion
reactions/create-for-team-discussion-in-.description: Create a reaction to a team discussion. OAuth access tokens require the write:discussion scope. A response with an HTTP 200 status means that you already added the reaction type to this team discussion.

reactions/delete-for-team-discussion.label: Delete team discussion reaction

actions/list-artifacts-for-repo.label: List artifacts for a repository
actions/list-artifacts-for-repo.description: Lists all artifacts for a repository. Anyone with read access to the repository can use this endpoint. If the repository is private you must use an access token with the repo scope.

actions/get-artifact.label: Get an artifact
actions/get-artifact.description: Gets a specific artifact for a workflow run. Anyone with read access to the repository can use this endpoint. If the repository is private you must use an access token with the repo scope.

actions/delete-artifact.label: Delete an artifact
actions/delete-artifact.description: Deletes an artifact for a workflow run. You must authenticate using an access token with the repo scope to use this endpoint. GitHub Apps must have the actions:write permission to use this endpoint.

actions/download-artifact.label: Download an artifact
actions/download-artifact.description: Gets a redirect URL to download an archive for a repository. This URL expires after 1 minute. Look for Location: in the response header to find the URL for the download. The :archive_format must be zip.

actions/get-actions-cache-usage.label: Get GitHub Actions cache usage for a repository
actions/get-actions-cache-usage.description: Gets GitHub Actions cache usage for a repository. The data fetched using this API is refreshed approximately every 5 minutes, so values returned from this endpoint may take at least 5 minutes to get updated.

actions/get-actions-cache-list.label: List GitHub Actions caches for a repository
actions/get-actions-cache-list.description: Lists the GitHub Actions caches for a repository. You must authenticate using an access token with the repo scope to use this endpoint. GitHub Apps must have the actions:read permission to use this endpoint.

actions/delete-actions-cache-by-key.label: Delete GitHub Actions caches for a repository (using a cache key)
actions/delete-actions-cache-by-key.description: Deletes one or more GitHub Actions caches for a repository, using a complete cache key. By default, all caches that match the provided key are deleted, but you can optionally provide a Git ref to restrict deletions to…

actions/delete-actions-cache-by-id.label: Delete a GitHub Actions cache for a repository (using a cache ID)
actions/delete-actions-cache-by-id.description: Deletes a GitHub Actions cache for a repository, using a cache ID.

actions/get-job-for-workflow-run.label: Get a job for a workflow run
actions/get-job-for-workflow-run.description: Gets a specific job in a workflow run. Anyone with read access to the repository can use this endpoint. If the repository is private you must use an access token with the repo scope.

actions/download-job-logs-for-workflow-r.label: Download job logs for a workflow run
actions/download-job-logs-for-workflow-r.description: Gets a redirect URL to download a plain text file of logs for a workflow job. This link expires after 1 minute. Look for Location: in the response header to find the URL for the download.

actions/re-run-job-for-workflow-run.label: Re-run a job from a workflow run
actions/re-run-job-for-workflow-run.description: Re-run a job and its dependent jobs in a workflow run.

actions/get-custom-oidc-sub-claim-for-re.label: Get the customization template for an OIDC subject claim for a repository
actions/get-custom-oidc-sub-claim-for-re.description: Gets the customization template for an OpenID Connect (OIDC) subject claim. You must authenticate using an access token with the repo scope to use this endpoint.

actions/set-custom-oidc-sub-claim-for-re.label: Set the customization template for an OIDC subject claim for a repository
actions/set-custom-oidc-sub-claim-for-re.description: Sets the customization template and opt-in or opt-out flag for an OpenID Connect (OIDC) subject claim for a repository. You must authenticate using an access token with the repo scope to use this endpoint.

actions/list-repo-organization-secrets.label: List repository organization secrets
actions/list-repo-organization-secrets.description: Lists all organization secrets shared with a repository without revealing their encrypted values.

actions/list-repo-organization-variables.label: List repository organization variables
actions/list-repo-organization-variables.description: Lists all organiation variables shared with a repository.

actions/get-github-actions-permissions-r.label: Get GitHub Actions permissions for a repository
actions/get-github-actions-permissions-r.description: Gets the GitHub Actions permissions policy for a repository, including whether GitHub Actions is enabled and the actions and reusable workflows allowed to run in the repository.

actions/set-github-actions-permissions-r.label: Set GitHub Actions permissions for a repository
actions/set-github-actions-permissions-r.description: Sets the GitHub Actions permissions policy for enabling GitHub Actions and allowed actions and reusable workflows in the repository.

actions/get-workflow-access-to-repositor.label: Get the level of access for workflows outside of the repository
actions/get-workflow-access-to-repositor.description: Gets the level of access that workflows outside of the repository have to actions and reusable workflows in the repository. This endpoint only applies to private repositories.

actions/set-workflow-access-to-repositor.label: Set the level of access for workflows outside of the repository
actions/set-workflow-access-to-repositor.description: Sets the level of access that workflows outside of the repository have to actions and reusable workflows in the repository. This endpoint only applies to private repositories.

actions/get-allowed-actions-repository.label: Get allowed actions and reusable workflows for a repository
actions/get-allowed-actions-repository.description: Gets the settings for selected actions and reusable workflows that are allowed in a repository. To use this endpoint, the repository policy for allowed_actions must be configured to selected.

actions/set-allowed-actions-repository.label: Set allowed actions and reusable workflows for a repository
actions/set-allowed-actions-repository.description: Sets the actions and reusable workflows that are allowed in a repository. To use this endpoint, the repository permission policy for allowed_actions must be configured to selected.

actions/get-github-actions-default-workf.label: Get default workflow permissions for a repository
actions/get-github-actions-default-workf.description: Gets the default workflow permissions granted to the GITHUB_TOKEN when running workflows in a repository, as well as if GitHub Actions can submit approving pull request reviews.

actions/set-github-actions-default-workf.label: Set default workflow permissions for a repository
actions/set-github-actions-default-workf.description: Sets the default workflow permissions granted to the GITHUB_TOKEN when running workflows in a repository, and sets if GitHub Actions can submit approving pull request reviews.

actions/list-self-hosted-runners-for-rep.label: List self-hosted runners for a repository
actions/list-self-hosted-runners-for-rep.description: Lists all self-hosted runners configured in a repository.

actions/list-runner-applications-for-rep.label: List runner applications for a repository
actions/list-runner-applications-for-rep.description: Lists binaries for the runner application that you can download and run.

actions/generate-runner-jitconfig-for-re.label: Create configuration for a just-in-time runner for a repository
actions/generate-runner-jitconfig-for-re.description: Generates a configuration that can be passed to the runner application at startup.

actions/create-registration-token-for-re.label: Create a registration token for a repository
actions/create-registration-token-for-re.description: Returns a token that you can pass to the config script. The token expires after one hour.

actions/create-remove-token-for-repo.label: Create a remove token for a repository
actions/create-remove-token-for-repo.description: Returns a token that you can pass to remove a self-hosted runner from a repository. The token expires after one hour.

actions/get-self-hosted-runner-for-repo.label: Get a self-hosted runner for a repository
actions/get-self-hosted-runner-for-repo.description: Gets a specific self-hosted runner configured in a repository.

actions/delete-self-hosted-runner-from-r.label: Delete a self-hosted runner from a repository
actions/delete-self-hosted-runner-from-r.description: Forces the removal of a self-hosted runner from a repository. You can use this endpoint to completely remove the runner when the machine you were using no longer exists.

actions/list-labels-for-self-hosted-runn.label: List labels for a self-hosted runner for a repository
actions/list-labels-for-self-hosted-runn.description: Lists all labels for a self-hosted runner configured in a repository.

actions/set-custom-labels-for-self-hoste.label: Set custom labels for a self-hosted runner for a repository
actions/set-custom-labels-for-self-hoste.description: Remove all previous custom labels and set the new custom labels for a specific self-hosted runner configured in a repository.

actions/add-custom-labels-to-self-hosted.label: Add custom labels to a self-hosted runner for a repository
actions/add-custom-labels-to-self-hosted.description: Add custom labels to a self-hosted runner configured in a repository.

actions/remove-all-custom-labels-from-se.label: Remove all custom labels from a self-hosted runner for a repository
actions/remove-all-custom-labels-from-se.description: Remove all custom labels from a self-hosted runner configured in a repository. Returns the remaining read-only labels from the runner.

actions/remove-custom-label-from-self-ho.label: Remove a custom label from a self-hosted runner for a repository
actions/remove-custom-label-from-self-ho.description: Remove a custom label from a self-hosted runner configured in a repository. Returns the remaining labels from the runner.

actions/list-workflow-runs-for-repo.label: List workflow runs for a repository
actions/list-workflow-runs-for-repo.description: Lists all workflow runs for a repository. You can use parameters to narrow the list of results. For more information about using parameters, see Parameters.

actions/get-workflow-run.label: Get a workflow run
actions/get-workflow-run.description: Gets a specific workflow run. Anyone with read access to the repository can use this endpoint. If the repository is private you must use an access token with the repo scope.

actions/delete-workflow-run.label: Delete a workflow run
actions/delete-workflow-run.description: Delete a specific workflow run. Anyone with write access to the repository can use this endpoint. If the repository is private you must use an access token with the repo scope.

actions/get-reviews-for-run.label: Get the review history for a workflow run
actions/get-reviews-for-run.description: Anyone with read access to the repository can use this endpoint. If the repository is private, you must use an access token with the repo scope. GitHub Apps must have the actions:read permission to use this endpoint.

actions/approve-workflow-run.label: Approve a workflow run for a fork pull request
actions/approve-workflow-run.description: Approves a workflow run for a pull request from a public fork of a first time contributor. For more information, see "Approving workflow runs from public forks."

actions/list-workflow-run-artifacts.label: List workflow run artifacts
actions/list-workflow-run-artifacts.description: Lists artifacts for a workflow run. Anyone with read access to the repository can use this endpoint. If the repository is private you must use an access token with the repo scope.

actions/get-workflow-run-attempt.label: Get a workflow run attempt
actions/get-workflow-run-attempt.description: Gets a specific workflow run attempt. Anyone with read access to the repository can use this endpoint. If the repository is private you must use an access token with the repo scope.

actions/list-jobs-for-workflow-run-attem.label: List jobs for a workflow run attempt
actions/list-jobs-for-workflow-run-attem.description: Lists jobs for a specific workflow run attempt. Anyone with read access to the repository can use this endpoint. If the repository is private you must use an access token with the repo scope.

actions/download-workflow-run-attempt-lo.label: Download workflow run attempt logs
actions/download-workflow-run-attempt-lo.description: Gets a redirect URL to download an archive of log files for a specific workflow run attempt. This link expires after 1 minute. Look for Location: in the response header to find the URL for the download.

actions/cancel-workflow-run.label: Cancel a workflow run
actions/cancel-workflow-run.description: Cancels a workflow run using its id.

actions/review-custom-gates-for-run.label: Review custom deployment protection rules for a workflow run
actions/review-custom-gates-for-run.description: Approve or reject custom deployment protection rules provided by a GitHub App for a workflow run. For more information, see "Using environments for deployment."

actions/force-cancel-workflow-run.label: Force cancel a workflow run
actions/force-cancel-workflow-run.description: Cancels a workflow run and bypasses conditions that would otherwise cause a workflow execution to continue, such as an always() condition on a job.

actions/list-jobs-for-workflow-run.label: List jobs for a workflow run
actions/list-jobs-for-workflow-run.description: Lists jobs for a workflow run. Anyone with read access to the repository can use this endpoint. If the repository is private you must use an access token with the repo scope.

actions/download-workflow-run-logs.label: Download workflow run logs
actions/download-workflow-run-logs.description: Gets a redirect URL to download an archive of log files for a workflow run. This link expires after 1 minute. Look for Location: in the response header to find the URL for the download.

actions/delete-workflow-run-logs.label: Delete workflow run logs
actions/delete-workflow-run-logs.description: Deletes all logs for a workflow run. You must authenticate using an access token with the repo scope to use this endpoint. GitHub Apps must have the actions:write permission to use this endpoint.

actions/get-pending-deployments-for-run.label: Get pending deployments for a workflow run
actions/get-pending-deployments-for-run.description: Get all deployment environments for a workflow run that are waiting for protection rules to pass.

actions/review-pending-deployments-for-r.label: Review pending deployments for a workflow run
actions/review-pending-deployments-for-r.description: Approve or reject pending deployments that are waiting on approval by a required reviewer.

actions/re-run-workflow.label: Re-run a workflow
actions/re-run-workflow.description: Re-runs your workflow run using its id. You must authenticate using an access token with the repo scope to use this endpoint. GitHub Apps must have the actions:write permission to use this endpoint.

actions/re-run-workflow-failed-jobs.label: Re-run failed jobs from a workflow run
actions/re-run-workflow-failed-jobs.description: Re-run all of the failed jobs and their dependent jobs in a workflow run using the id of the workflow run. You must authenticate using an access token with the repo scope to use this endpoint.

actions/get-workflow-run-usage.label: Get workflow run usage
actions/get-workflow-run-usage.description: Gets the number of billable minutes and total run time for a specific workflow run. Billable minutes only apply to workflows in private repositories that use GitHub-hosted runners.

actions/list-repo-secrets.label: List repository secrets (Actions)
actions/list-repo-secrets.description: Lists all secrets available in a repository without revealing their encrypted values.

actions/get-repo-public-key.label: Get a repository public key (Actions)
actions/get-repo-public-key.description: Gets your public key, which you need to encrypt secrets. You need to encrypt a secret before you can create or update secrets.

actions/get-repo-secret.label: Get a repository secret (Actions)
actions/get-repo-secret.description: Gets a single repository secret without revealing its encrypted value.

actions/create-or-update-repo-secret.label: Create or update a repository secret (Actions)
actions/create-or-update-repo-secret.description: Creates or updates a repository secret with an encrypted value. Encrypt your secret using LibSodium. For more information, see "Encrypting secrets for the REST API."

actions/delete-repo-secret.label: Delete a repository secret (Actions)
actions/delete-repo-secret.description: Deletes a secret in a repository using the secret name.
