actions/create-repo-variable.label: Create a repository variable
actions/create-repo-variable.description: Creates a repository variable that you can reference in a GitHub Actions workflow.

actions/get-repo-variable.label: Get a repository variable
actions/get-repo-variable.description: Gets a specific variable in a repository.

actions/delete-repo-variable.label: Delete a repository variable
actions/delete-repo-variable.description: Deletes a repository variable using the variable name.

actions/update-repo-variable.label: Update a repository variable
actions/update-repo-variable.description: Updates a repository variable that you can reference in a GitHub Actions workflow.

actions/list-repo-workflows.label: List repository workflows
actions/list-repo-workflows.description: Lists the workflows in a repository. Anyone with read access to the repository can use this endpoint. If the repository is private you must use an access token with the repo scope.

actions/get-workflow.label: Get a workflow
actions/get-workflow.description: Gets a specific workflow. You can replace workflow_id with the workflow file name. For example, you could use main.yaml. Anyone with read access to the repository can use this endpoint.

actions/disable-workflow.label: Disable a workflow
actions/disable-workflow.description: Disables a workflow and sets the state of the workflow to disabled_manually. You can replace workflow_id with the workflow file name. For example, you could use main.yaml.

actions/create-workflow-dispatch.label: Create a workflow dispatch event
actions/create-workflow-dispatch.description: You can use this endpoint to manually trigger a GitHub Actions workflow run. You can replace workflow_id with the workflow file name. For example, you could use main.yaml.

actions/enable-workflow.label: Enable a workflow
actions/enable-workflow.description: Enables a workflow and sets the state of the workflow to active. You can replace workflow_id with the workflow file name. For example, you could use main.yaml.

actions/list-workflow-runs.label: List workflow runs for a workflow
actions/list-workflow-runs.description: List all workflow runs for a workflow. You can replace workflow_id with the workflow file name. For example, you could use main.yaml. You can use parameters to narrow the list of results.

actions/get-workflow-usage.label: Get workflow usage
actions/get-workflow-usage.description: Gets the number of billable minutes used by a specific workflow during the current billing cycle. Billable minutes only apply to workflows in private repositories that use GitHub-hosted runners.

repos/list-activities.label: List repository activities
repos/list-activities.description: Lists a detailed history of changes to a repository, such as pushes, merges, force pushes, and branch changes, and associates these changes with commits and users.

issues/list-assignees.label: List assignees
issues/list-assignees.description: Lists the available assignees for issues in a repository.

issues/check-user-can-be-assigned.label: Check if a user can be assigned
issues/check-user-can-be-assigned.description: Checks if a user has permission to be assigned to an issue in this repository.

repos/list-autolinks.label: List all autolinks of a repository
repos/list-autolinks.description: This returns a list of autolinks configured for the given repository.

repos/create-autolink.label: Create an autolink reference for a repository
repos/create-autolink.description: Users with admin access to the repository can create an autolink.

repos/get-autolink.label: Get an autolink reference of a repository
repos/get-autolink.description: This returns a single autolink reference by ID that was configured for the given repository.

repos/delete-autolink.label: Delete an autolink reference from a repository
repos/delete-autolink.description: This deletes a single autolink reference by ID that was configured for the given repository.

repos/check-automated-security-fixes.label: Check if automated security fixes are enabled for a repository
repos/check-automated-security-fixes.description: Shows whether automated security fixes are enabled, disabled or paused for a repository. The authenticated user must have admin read access to the repository.

repos/enable-automated-security-fixes.label: Enable automated security fixes
repos/enable-automated-security-fixes.description: Enables automated security fixes for a repository. The authenticated user must have admin access to the repository. For more information, see "Configuring automated security fixes".

repos/disable-automated-security-fixes.label: Disable automated security fixes
repos/disable-automated-security-fixes.description: Disables automated security fixes for a repository. The authenticated user must have admin access to the repository. For more information, see "Configuring automated security fixes".

interactions/get-restrictions-for-repo.label: Get interaction restrictions for a repository
interactions/get-restrictions-for-repo.description: Shows which type of GitHub user can interact with this repository and when the restriction expires. If there are no restrictions, you will see an empty response.

interactions/set-restrictions-for-repo.label: Set interaction restrictions for a repository
interactions/set-restrictions-for-repo.description: Temporarily restricts interactions to a certain type of GitHub user within the given repository. You must have owner or admin access to set these restrictions.

interactions/remove-restrictions-for-rep.label: Remove interaction restrictions for a repository
interactions/remove-restrictions-for-rep.description: Removes all interaction restrictions from the given repository. You must have owner or admin access to remove restrictions.

repos/list-invitations.label: List repository invitations
repos/list-invitations.description: When authenticating as a user with admin rights to a repository, this endpoint will list all currently open repository invitations.

issues/list-for-repo.label: List repository issues
issues/list-for-repo.description: List issues in a repository. Only open issues will be listed.

issues/create.label: Create an issue
issues/create.description: Any user with pull access to a repository can create an issue. If issues are disabled in the repository, the API returns a 410 Gone status.

issues/list-comments-for-repo.label: List issue comments for a repository
issues/list-comments-for-repo.description: You can use the REST API to list comments on issues and pull requests for a repository. Every pull request is an issue, but not every issue is a pull request.

issues/get-comment.label: Get an issue comment
issues/get-comment.description: You can use the REST API to get comments on issues and pull requests. Every pull request is an issue, but not every issue is a pull request.

issues/delete-comment.label: Delete an issue comment
issues/delete-comment.description: You can use the REST API to delete comments on issues and pull requests. Every pull request is an issue, but not every issue is a pull request.

issues/update-comment.label: Update an issue comment
issues/update-comment.description: You can use the REST API to update comments on issues and pull requests. Every pull request is an issue, but not every issue is a pull request.

reactions/list-for-issue-comment.label: List reactions for an issue comment
reactions/list-for-issue-comment.description: List the reactions to an issue comment.

reactions/create-for-issue-comment.label: Create reaction for an issue comment
reactions/create-for-issue-comment.description: Create a reaction to an issue comment. A response with an HTTP 200 status means that you already added the reaction type to this issue comment.

reactions/delete-for-issue-comment.label: Delete an issue comment reaction
reactions/delete-for-issue-comment.description: Delete a reaction to an issue comment.

issues/list-events-for-repo.label: List issue events for a repository

issues/get-event.label: Get an issue event
issues/get-event.description: Gets a single event by the event id.

issues/get.label: Get an issue
issues/get.description: The API returns a 301 Moved Permanently status if the issue was transferred to another repository.

issues/update.label: Update an issue
issues/update.description: Issue owners and users with push access can edit an issue.
issues/update.hint: Also how you close or reopen an issue: set 'state' to closed/open. There is no separate close-issue operation. 'Lock an issue' only freezes the conversation, it does not close the issue.

issues/add-assignees.label: Add assignees to an issue
issues/add-assignees.description: Adds up to 10 assignees to an issue. Users already assigned to an issue are not replaced.

issues/remove-assignees.label: Remove assignees from an issue
issues/remove-assignees.description: Removes one or more assignees from an issue.

issues/check-user-can-be-assigned-to-iss.label: Check if a user can be assigned to a issue
issues/check-user-can-be-assigned-to-iss.description: Checks if a user has permission to be assigned to a specific issue.

issues/list-comments.label: List issue comments
issues/list-comments.description: You can use the REST API to list comments on issues and pull requests. Every pull request is an issue, but not every issue is a pull request.

issues/create-comment.label: Create an issue comment
issues/create-comment.description: You can use the REST API to create comments on issues and pull requests. Every pull request is an issue, but not every issue is a pull request.
issues/create-comment.hint: Works for both issues and pull requests (a PR is an issue). For inline review comments on a PR diff use the pulls review-comment operations.

issues/list-events.label: List issue events
issues/list-events.description: Lists all events for an issue.

issues/list-labels-on-issue.label: List labels for an issue
issues/list-labels-on-issue.description: Lists all labels for an issue.

issues/set-labels.label: Set labels for an issue
issues/set-labels.description: Removes any previous labels and sets the new labels for an issue.

issues/add-labels.label: Add labels to an issue
issues/add-labels.description: Adds labels to an issue. If you provide an empty array of labels, all labels are removed from the issue.

issues/remove-all-labels.label: Remove all labels from an issue
issues/remove-all-labels.description: Removes all labels from an issue.

issues/remove-label.label: Remove a label from an issue
issues/remove-label.description: Removes the specified label from the issue, and returns the remaining labels on the issue. This endpoint returns a 404 Not Found status if the label does not exist.

issues/lock.label: Lock an issue
issues/lock.description: Users with push access can lock an issue or pull request's conversation.
issues/lock.hint: Locks the conversation (no new comments) but does NOT close the issue. To close an issue use 'Update an issue' with state=closed.

issues/unlock.label: Unlock an issue
issues/unlock.description: Users with push access can unlock an issue's conversation.

reactions/list-for-issue.label: List reactions for an issue
reactions/list-for-issue.description: List the reactions to an issue.

reactions/create-for-issue.label: Create reaction for an issue
reactions/create-for-issue.description: Create a reaction to an issue. A response with an HTTP 200 status means that you already added the reaction type to this issue.

reactions/delete-for-issue.label: Delete an issue reaction
reactions/delete-for-issue.description: Delete a reaction to an issue.

issues/list-events-for-timeline.label: List timeline events for an issue
issues/list-events-for-timeline.description: List all timeline events for an issue.

repos/create-deploy-key.label: Create a deploy key
repos/create-deploy-key.description: You can create a read-only deploy key.

repos/delete-deploy-key.label: Delete a deploy key
repos/delete-deploy-key.description: Deploy keys are immutable. If you need to update a key, remove the key and create a new one instead.

issues/list-labels-for-repo.label: List labels for a repository
issues/list-labels-for-repo.description: Lists all labels for a repository.

issues/create-label.label: Create a label
issues/create-label.description: Creates a label for the specified repository with the given name and color. The name and color parameters are required. The color must be a valid hexadecimal color code.

issues/get-label.label: Get a label
issues/get-label.description: Gets a label using the given name.

issues/delete-label.label: Delete a label
issues/delete-label.description: Deletes a label using the given label name.

issues/update-label.label: Update a label
issues/update-label.description: Updates a label using the given label name.

repos/list-languages.label: List repository languages
repos/list-languages.description: Lists languages for the specified repository. The value shown for each language is the number of bytes of code written in that language.

licenses/get-for-repo.label: Get the license for a repository
licenses/get-for-repo.description: This method returns the contents of the repository's license file, if one is detected.

repos/merge-upstream.label: Sync a fork branch with the upstream repository
repos/merge-upstream.description: Sync a branch of a forked repository to keep it up-to-date with the upstream repository.

issues/get-milestone.label: Get a milestone
issues/get-milestone.description: Gets a milestone using the given milestone number.

issues/delete-milestone.label: Delete a milestone
issues/delete-milestone.description: Deletes a milestone using the given milestone number.

issues/list-labels-for-milestone.label: List labels for issues in a milestone
issues/list-labels-for-milestone.description: Lists labels for issues in a milestone.

activity/list-repo-notifications-for-aut.label: List repository notifications for the authenticated user
activity/list-repo-notifications-for-aut.description: Lists all notifications for the current user in the specified repository.

activity/mark-repo-notifications-as-read.label: Mark repository notifications as read
activity/mark-repo-notifications-as-read.description: Marks all notifications in a repository as "read" for the current user. If the number of notifications is too large to complete in one request, you will receive a 202 Accepted status and GitHub will run an asynchronous…

repos/get-pages.label: Get a GitHub Pages site
repos/get-pages.description: Gets information about a GitHub Pages site.

repos/update-information-about-pages-sit.label: Update information about a GitHub Pages site
repos/update-information-about-pages-sit.description: Updates information for a GitHub Pages site. For more information, see "About GitHub Pages.

repos/create-pages-site.label: Create a GitHub Pages site
repos/create-pages-site.description: Configures a GitHub Pages site. For more information, see "About GitHub Pages."

repos/delete-pages-site.label: Delete a GitHub Pages site
repos/delete-pages-site.description: Deletes a GitHub Pages site. For more information, see "About GitHub Pages.

repos/list-pages-builds.label: List GitHub Pages builds
repos/list-pages-builds.description: Lists builts of a GitHub Pages site.

repos/request-pages-build.label: Request a GitHub Pages build
repos/request-pages-build.description: You can request that your site be built from the latest revision on the default branch. This has the same effect as pushing a commit to your default branch, but does not require an additional commit.

repos/get-latest-pages-build.label: Get latest Pages build
repos/get-latest-pages-build.description: Gets information about the single most recent build of a GitHub Pages site.

repos/get-pages-build.label: Get GitHub Pages build
repos/get-pages-build.description: Gets information about a GitHub Pages build.

repos/create-pages-deployment.label: Create a GitHub Pages deployment
repos/create-pages-deployment.description: Create a GitHub Pages deployment for a repository.

repos/get-pages-health-check.label: Get a DNS health check for GitHub Pages
repos/get-pages-health-check.description: Gets a health check of the DNS settings for the CNAME record configured for a repository's GitHub Pages.

repos/enable-private-vulnerability-repor.label: Enable private vulnerability reporting for a repository
repos/enable-private-vulnerability-repor.description: Enables private vulnerability reporting for a repository. The authenticated user must have admin access to the repository. For more information, see "Privately reporting a security vulnerability."

repos/disable-private-vulnerability-repo.label: Disable private vulnerability reporting for a repository
repos/disable-private-vulnerability-repo.description: Disables private vulnerability reporting for a repository. The authenticated user must have admin access to the repository. For more information, see "Privately reporting a security vulnerability".

pulls/list.label: List pull requests
pulls/list.description: Draft pull requests are available in public repositories with GitHub Free and GitHub Free for organizations, GitHub Pro, and legacy per-repository billing plans, and in public and private repositories with GitHub Team…

pulls/create.label: Create a pull request
pulls/create.description: Draft pull requests are available in public repositories with GitHub Free and GitHub Free for organizations, GitHub Pro, and legacy per-repository billing plans, and in public and private repositories with GitHub Team…

pulls/list-review-comments-for-repo.label: List review comments in a repository
pulls/list-review-comments-for-repo.description: Lists review comments for all pull requests in a repository. By default, review comments are in ascending order by ID.

pulls/get-review-comment.label: Get a review comment for a pull request
pulls/get-review-comment.description: Provides details for a review comment.

pulls/delete-review-comment.label: Delete a review comment for a pull request

pulls/update-review-comment.label: Update a review comment for a pull request
pulls/update-review-comment.description: Enables you to edit a review comment.

reactions/list-for-pull-request-review-c.label: List reactions for a pull request review comment
reactions/list-for-pull-request-review-c.description: List the reactions to a pull request review comment.

reactions/create-for-pull-request-review.label: Create reaction for a pull request review comment
reactions/create-for-pull-request-review.description: Create a reaction to a pull request review comment. A response with an HTTP 200 status means that you already added the reaction type to this pull request review comment.

reactions/delete-for-pull-request-commen.label: Delete a pull request comment reaction
reactions/delete-for-pull-request-commen.description: Delete a reaction to a pull request review comment.

pulls/get.label: Get a pull request
pulls/get.description: Draft pull requests are available in public repositories with GitHub Free and GitHub Free for organizations, GitHub Pro, and legacy per-repository billing plans, and in public and private repositories with GitHub Team…

pulls/update.label: Update a pull request
pulls/update.description: Draft pull requests are available in public repositories with GitHub Free and GitHub Free for organizations, GitHub Pro, and legacy per-repository billing plans, and in public and private repositories with GitHub Team…
pulls/update.hint: Edits PR title, body, base branch, or state (use state=closed to close WITHOUT merging). To merge use 'Merge a pull request'; to sync the branch with base use 'Update a pull request branch'.

codespaces/create-with-pr-for-authentica.label: Create a codespace from a pull request
codespaces/create-with-pr-for-authentica.description: Creates a codespace owned by the authenticated user for the specified pull request.

pulls/list-review-comments.label: List review comments on a pull request
pulls/list-review-comments.description: Lists all review comments for a pull request. By default, review comments are in ascending order by ID.

pulls/create-review-comment.label: Create a review comment for a pull request
pulls/create-review-comment.description: Creates a review comment in the pull request diff. To add a regular comment to a pull request timeline, see "Create an issue comment." We recommend creating a review comment using line, side, and optionally start_line…

pulls/create-reply-for-review-comment.label: Create a reply for a review comment
pulls/create-reply-for-review-comment.description: Creates a reply to a review comment for a pull request. For the comment_id, provide the ID of the review comment you are replying to. This must be the ID of a top-level review comment, not a reply to that comment.

pulls/list-commits.label: List commits on a pull request
pulls/list-commits.description: Lists a maximum of 250 commits for a pull request. To receive a complete commit list for pull requests with more than 250 commits, use the List commits endpoint.

pulls/list-files.label: List pull requests files
pulls/list-files.description: Note: Responses include a maximum of 3000 files. The paginated response returns 30 files per page by default.

pulls/check-if-merged.label: Check if a pull request has been merged
pulls/check-if-merged.description: Checks if a pull request has been merged into the base branch. The HTTP status of the response indicates whether or not the pull request has been merged; the response body is empty.

pulls/merge.label: Merge a pull request
pulls/merge.description: Merges a pull request into the base branch. This endpoint triggers notifications. Creating content too quickly using this endpoint may result in secondary rate limiting.
pulls/merge.hint: Merges the PR into its base branch. Not to be confused with 'Update a pull request' (edits title/body/state) or 'Update a pull request branch' (pulls base changes INTO the PR branch).

pulls/list-requested-reviewers.label: Get all requested reviewers for a pull request
pulls/list-requested-reviewers.description: Gets the users or teams whose review is requested for a pull request. Once a requested reviewer submits a review, they are no longer considered a requested reviewer.

pulls/request-reviewers.label: Request reviewers for a pull request
pulls/request-reviewers.description: Requests reviews for a pull request from a given set of users and/or teams. This endpoint triggers notifications. Creating content too quickly using this endpoint may result in secondary rate limiting.

pulls/remove-requested-reviewers.label: Remove requested reviewers from a pull request
pulls/remove-requested-reviewers.description: Removes review requests from a pull request for a given set of users and/or teams.

pulls/list-reviews.label: List reviews for a pull request
pulls/list-reviews.description: The list of reviews returns in chronological order.

pulls/create-review.label: Create a review for a pull request
pulls/create-review.description: This endpoint triggers notifications. Creating content too quickly using this endpoint may result in secondary rate limiting. See "Secondary rate limits" and "Dealing with secondary rate limits" for details.

pulls/get-review.label: Get a review for a pull request
pulls/get-review.description: Retrieves a pull request review by its ID.

pulls/update-review.label: Update a review for a pull request
pulls/update-review.description: Update the review summary comment with new text.

pulls/delete-pending-review.label: Delete a pending review for a pull request
pulls/delete-pending-review.description: Deletes a pull request review that has not been submitted. Submitted reviews cannot be deleted.

pulls/list-comments-for-review.label: List comments for a pull request review
pulls/list-comments-for-review.description: List comments for a specific pull request review.

pulls/dismiss-review.label: Dismiss a review for a pull request
pulls/dismiss-review.description: Note: To dismiss a pull request review on a protected branch, you must be a repository administrator or be included in the list of people or teams who can dismiss pull request reviews.

pulls/submit-review.label: Submit a review for a pull request
pulls/submit-review.description: Submits a pending review for a pull request. For more information about creating a pending review for a pull request, see "Create a review for a pull request."

pulls/update-branch.label: Update a pull request branch
pulls/update-branch.description: Updates the pull request branch with the latest upstream changes by merging HEAD from the base branch into the pull request branch.
pulls/update-branch.hint: Updates the PR's head branch with latest changes from the base branch (the 'Update branch' button in the GitHub UI). Does not merge the PR and does not edit PR fields.

repos/get-readme.label: Get a repository README
repos/get-readme.description: Gets the preferred README for a repository.
repos/get-readme.hint: Returns the repository README specifically (rendered from the default location). For any other file use 'Get repository content'.

repos/get-readme-in-directory.label: Get a repository README for a directory
repos/get-readme-in-directory.description: Gets the README from a repository directory.

repos/list-releases.label: List releases
repos/list-releases.description: This returns a list of releases, which does not include regular Git tags that have not been associated with a release. To get a list of Git tags, use the Repository Tags API.

repos/create-release.label: Create a release
repos/create-release.description: Users with push access to the repository can create a release.

repos/get-release-asset.label: Get a release asset
repos/get-release-asset.description: To download the asset's binary content, set the Accept header of the request to application/octet-stream. The API will either redirect the client to the location, or stream it directly if possible.

repos/update-release-asset.label: Update a release asset
repos/update-release-asset.description: Users with push access to the repository can edit a release asset.

repos/generate-release-notes.label: Generate release notes content for a release
repos/generate-release-notes.description: Generate a name and body describing a release. The body content will be markdown formatted and contain information like the changes since last release and users who contributed.

repos/get-latest-release.label: Get the latest release
repos/get-latest-release.description: View the latest published full release for the repository.
repos/get-latest-release.hint: Returns the most recent non-prerelease, non-draft release. 'Get a release' fetches by release ID; 'Get a release by tag name' fetches by git tag (e.g. v1.2.0).

repos/get-release-by-tag.label: Get a release by tag name
repos/get-release-by-tag.description: Get a published release with the specified tag.
repos/get-release-by-tag.hint: Fetches a release by its git tag name (e.g. v1.2.0). Use 'Get a release' if you have the numeric release ID.

repos/get-release.label: Get a release
repos/get-release.description: Note: This returns an upload_url key corresponding to the endpoint for uploading release assets. This key is a hypermedia resource.
repos/get-release.hint: Fetches a release by its numeric release ID (not a tag name). Use 'Get a release by tag name' for tags like v1.2.0, or 'Get the latest release' for the newest one.

repos/delete-release.label: Delete a release
repos/delete-release.description: Users with push access to the repository can delete a release.

repos/update-release.label: Update a release
repos/update-release.description: Users with push access to the repository can edit a release.

repos/upload-release-asset.label: Upload a release asset
repos/upload-release-asset.description: This endpoint makes use of a Hypermedia relation to determine which URL to access. The endpoint you call to upload release assets is specific to your release.

reactions/list-for-release.label: List reactions for a release
reactions/list-for-release.description: List the reactions to a release.

reactions/create-for-release.label: Create reaction for a release
reactions/create-for-release.description: Create a reaction to a release. A response with a Status: 200 OK means that you already added the reaction type to this release.

reactions/delete-for-release.label: Delete a release reaction
reactions/delete-for-release.description: Delete a reaction to a release.

repos/get-branch-rules.label: Get rules for a branch
repos/get-branch-rules.description: Returns all active rules that apply to the specified branch. The branch does not need to exist; rules that would apply to a branch with that name will be returned.

repos/get-repo-rulesets.label: Get all repository rulesets
repos/get-repo-rulesets.description: Get all the rulesets for a repository.

repos/create-repo-ruleset.label: Create a repository ruleset
repos/create-repo-ruleset.description: Create a ruleset for a repository.

repos/get-repo-rule-suites.label: List repository rule suites
repos/get-repo-rule-suites.description: Lists suites of rule evaluations at the repository level. For more information, see "Managing rulesets for a repository."

repos/get-repo-rule-suite.label: Get a repository rule suite
repos/get-repo-rule-suite.description: Gets information about a suite of rule evaluations from within a repository. For more information, see "Managing rulesets for a repository."

repos/get-repo-ruleset.label: Get a repository ruleset
repos/get-repo-ruleset.description: Get a ruleset for a repository.

repos/update-repo-ruleset.label: Update a repository ruleset
repos/update-repo-ruleset.description: Update a ruleset for a repository.

repos/delete-repo-ruleset.label: Delete a repository ruleset
repos/delete-repo-ruleset.description: Delete a ruleset for a repository.

secret-scanning/get-alert.label: Get a secret scanning alert
secret-scanning/get-alert.description: Gets a single secret scanning alert detected in an eligible repository. To use this endpoint, you must be an administrator for the repository or for the organization that owns the repository, and you must use a personal…

secret-scanning/update-alert.label: Update a secret scanning alert
secret-scanning/update-alert.description: Updates the status of a secret scanning alert in an eligible repository. To use this endpoint, you must be an administrator for the repository or for the organization that owns the repository, and you must use a…

secret-scanning/list-locations-for-alert.label: List locations for a secret scanning alert
secret-scanning/list-locations-for-alert.description: Lists all locations for a given secret scanning alert for an eligible repository. To use this endpoint, you must be an administrator for the repository or for the organization that owns the repository, and you must use…

security-advisories/list-repository-advi.label: List repository security advisories
security-advisories/list-repository-advi.description: Lists security advisories in a repository. You must authenticate using an access token with the repo scope or repository_advisories:read permission in order to get published security advisories in a private repository…

security-advisories/create-repository-ad.label: Create a repository security advisory
security-advisories/create-repository-ad.description: Creates a new repository security advisory. You must authenticate using an access token with the repo scope or repository_advisories:write permission to use this endpoint.

security-advisories/create-private-vulne.label: Privately report a security vulnerability
security-advisories/create-private-vulne.description: Report a security vulnerability to the maintainers of the repository. See "Privately reporting a security vulnerability" for more information about private vulnerability reporting.

security-advisories/get-repository-advis.label: Get a repository security advisory
security-advisories/get-repository-advis.description: Get a repository security advisory using its GitHub Security Advisory (GHSA) identifier. You can access any published security advisory on a public repository.

security-advisories/update-repository-ad.label: Update a repository security advisory
security-advisories/update-repository-ad.description: Update a repository security advisory using its GitHub Security Advisory (GHSA) identifier. You must authenticate using an access token with the repo scope or repository_advisories:write permission to use this endpoint.

security-advisories/create-repository-ad.label: Request a CVE for a repository security advisory
security-advisories/create-repository-ad.description: If you want a CVE identification number for the security vulnerability in your project, and don't already have one, you can request a CVE identification number from GitHub.

activity/list-stargazers-for-repo.label: List stargazers
activity/list-stargazers-for-repo.description: Lists the people that have starred the repository.

repos/get-code-frequency-stats.label: Get the weekly commit activity
repos/get-code-frequency-stats.description: Returns a weekly aggregate of the number of additions and deletions pushed to a repository.

repos/get-commit-activity-stats.label: Get the last year of commit activity
repos/get-commit-activity-stats.description: Returns the last year of commit activity grouped by week. The days array is a group of commits per day, starting on Sunday.

repos/get-contributors-stats.label: Get all contributor commit activity

repos/get-participation-stats.label: Get the weekly commit count
repos/get-participation-stats.description: Returns the total commit counts for the owner and total commit counts in all. all is everyone combined, including the owner in the last 52 weeks.

repos/get-punch-card-stats.label: Get the hourly commit count for each day
repos/get-punch-card-stats.description: Each array contains the day number, hour number, and number of commits:

repos/create-commit-status.label: Create a commit status
repos/create-commit-status.description: Users with push access in a repository can create commit statuses for a given SHA.

activity/list-watchers-for-repo.label: List watchers
activity/list-watchers-for-repo.description: Lists the people watching the specified repository.

activity/get-repo-subscription.label: Get a repository subscription
activity/get-repo-subscription.description: Gets information about whether the authenticated user is subscribed to the repository.

activity/set-repo-subscription.label: Set a repository subscription
activity/set-repo-subscription.description: If you would like to watch a repository, set subscribed to true. If you would like to ignore notifications made within a repository, set ignored to true.

activity/delete-repo-subscription.label: Delete a repository subscription
activity/delete-repo-subscription.description: This endpoint should only be used to stop watching a repository. To control whether or not you wish to receive notifications from a repository, set the repository's subscription manually.

repos/list-tag-protection.label: List tag protection states for a repository
repos/list-tag-protection.description: This returns the tag protection states of a repository.

repos/create-tag-protection.label: Create a tag protection state for a repository
repos/create-tag-protection.description: This creates a tag protection state for a repository. This endpoint is only available to repository administrators.

repos/delete-tag-protection.label: Delete a tag protection state for a repository
repos/delete-tag-protection.description: This deletes a tag protection state for a repository. This endpoint is only available to repository administrators.

repos/download-tarball-archive.label: Download a repository archive (tar)
repos/download-tarball-archive.description: Gets a redirect URL to download a tar archive for a repository. If you omit :ref, the repository’s default branch (usually main) will be used.

repos/list-teams.label: List repository teams
repos/list-teams.description: Lists the teams that have access to the specified repository and that are also visible to the authenticated user.

repos/get-clones.label: Get repository clones
repos/get-clones.description: Get the total number of clones and breakdown per day or week for the last 14 days. Timestamps are aligned to UTC midnight of the beginning of the day or week. Week begins on Monday.

repos/get-top-paths.label: Get top referral paths
repos/get-top-paths.description: Get the top 10 popular contents over the last 14 days.

repos/get-top-referrers.label: Get top referral sources
repos/get-top-referrers.description: Get the top 10 referrers over the last 14 days.

repos/get-views.label: Get page views
repos/get-views.description: Get the total number of views and breakdown per day or week for the last 14 days. Timestamps are aligned to UTC midnight of the beginning of the day or week. Week begins on Monday.

repos/transfer.label: Transfer a repository
repos/transfer.description: A transfer request will need to be accepted by the new owner when transferring a personal repository to another user. The response will contain the original owner, and the transfer will continue asynchronously.

actions/update-environment-variable.label: Update an environment variable

users/delete-social-account-for-authenti.description: Deletes one or more social accounts from the authenticated user's profile. This endpoint is accessible with the user scope.

users/list-ssh-signing-keys-for-authenti.label: List SSH signing keys for the authenticated user
users/list-ssh-signing-keys-for-authenti.description: Lists the SSH signing keys for the authenticated user's GitHub account. You must authenticate with Basic Authentication, or you must authenticate with OAuth with at least read:ssh_signing_key scope.

users/create-ssh-signing-key-for-authent.label: Create a SSH signing key for the authenticated user
users/create-ssh-signing-key-for-authent.description: Creates an SSH signing key for the authenticated user's GitHub account. You must authenticate with Basic Authentication, or you must authenticate with OAuth with at least write:ssh_signing_key scope.

users/get-ssh-signing-key-for-authentica.label: Get an SSH signing key for the authenticated user
users/get-ssh-signing-key-for-authentica.description: Gets extended details for an SSH signing key. You must authenticate with Basic Authentication, or you must authenticate with OAuth with at least read:ssh_signing_key scope.

users/delete-ssh-signing-key-for-authent.label: Delete an SSH signing key for the authenticated user
users/delete-ssh-signing-key-for-authent.description: Deletes an SSH signing key from the authenticated user's GitHub account. You must authenticate with Basic Authentication, or you must authenticate with OAuth with at least admin:ssh_signing_key scope.

activity/list-repos-starred-by-authentic.label: List repositories starred by the authenticated user
activity/list-repos-starred-by-authentic.description: Lists repositories the authenticated user has starred.

activity/check-repo-is-starred-by-authen.label: Check if a repository is starred by the authenticated user
activity/check-repo-is-starred-by-authen.description: Whether the authenticated user has starred the repository.

activity/star-repo-for-authenticated-use.label: Star a repository for the authenticated user
activity/star-repo-for-authenticated-use.description: Note that you'll need to set Content-Length to zero when calling out to this endpoint. For more information, see "HTTP verbs."

activity/unstar-repo-for-authenticated-u.label: Unstar a repository for the authenticated user
activity/unstar-repo-for-authenticated-u.description: Unstar a repository that the authenticated user has previously starred.

activity/list-watched-repos-for-authenti.label: List repositories watched by the authenticated user
activity/list-watched-repos-for-authenti.description: Lists repositories the authenticated user is watching.

teams/list-for-authenticated-user.label: List teams for the authenticated user
teams/list-for-authenticated-user.description: List all of the teams across all of the organizations to which the authenticated user belongs. This method requires user, repo, or read:org scope when authenticating via OAuth.

users/list.label: List users
users/list.description: Lists all users, in the order that they signed up on GitHub. This list includes personal user accounts and organization accounts.

users/get-by-username.label: Get a user
users/get-by-username.description: Provides publicly available information about someone with a GitHub account.

packages/list-docker-migration-conflicti.label: Get list of conflicting packages during Docker migration for user
packages/list-docker-migration-conflicti.description: Lists all packages that are in a specific user's namespace, that the requesting user has access to, and that encountered a conflict during Docker migration.

activity/list-events-for-authenticated-u.label: List events for the authenticated user
activity/list-events-for-authenticated-u.description: If you are authenticated as the given user, you will see your private events. Otherwise, you'll only see public events.

activity/list-org-events-for-authenticat.label: List organization events for the authenticated user
activity/list-org-events-for-authenticat.description: This is the user's organization dashboard. You must be authenticated as the user to view this.

activity/list-public-events-for-user.label: List public events for a user

users/list-followers-for-user.label: List followers of a user
users/list-followers-for-user.description: Lists the people following the specified user.

users/list-following-for-user.label: List the people a user follows
users/list-following-for-user.description: Lists the people who the specified user follows.

users/check-following-for-user.label: Check if a user follows another user

gists/list-for-user.label: List gists for a user
gists/list-for-user.description: Lists public gists for the specified user:

users/list-gpg-keys-for-user.label: List GPG keys for a user
users/list-gpg-keys-for-user.description: Lists the GPG keys for a user. This information is accessible by anyone.

users/get-context-for-user.label: Get contextual information for a user
users/get-context-for-user.description: Provides hovercard information when authenticated through basic auth or OAuth with the repo scope. You can find out more about someone in relation to their pull requests, issues, repositories, and organizations.

apps/get-user-installation.label: Get a user installation for the authenticated app
apps/get-user-installation.description: Enables an authenticated GitHub App to find the user’s installation information.

users/list-public-keys-for-user.label: List public keys for a user
users/list-public-keys-for-user.description: Lists the verified public SSH keys for a user. This is accessible by anyone.

orgs/list-for-user.label: List organizations for a user
orgs/list-for-user.description: List public organization memberships for the specified user.

packages/list-packages-for-user.label: List packages for a user
packages/list-packages-for-user.description: Lists all packages in a user's namespace for which the requesting user has access.

packages/get-package-for-user.label: Get a package for a user
packages/get-package-for-user.description: Gets a specific package metadata for a public package owned by a user.

packages/delete-package-for-user.label: Delete a package for a user
packages/delete-package-for-user.description: Deletes an entire package for a user. You cannot delete a public package if any version of the package has more than 5,000 downloads. In this scenario, contact GitHub support for further assistance.

packages/restore-package-for-user.label: Restore a package for a user
packages/restore-package-for-user.description: Restores an entire package for a user.

packages/get-all-package-versions-for-pa.label: List package versions for a package owned by a user
packages/get-all-package-versions-for-pa.description: Lists package versions for a public package owned by a specified user.

packages/get-package-version-for-user.label: Get a package version for a user
packages/get-package-version-for-user.description: Gets a specific package version for a public package owned by a specified user.

packages/delete-package-version-for-user.label: Delete package version for a user
packages/delete-package-version-for-user.description: Deletes a specific package version for a user. If the package is public and the package version has more than 5,000 downloads, you cannot delete the package version.

packages/restore-package-version-for-use.label: Restore package version for a user
packages/restore-package-version-for-use.description: Restores a specific package version for a user.

activity/list-received-events-for-user.label: List events received by the authenticated user
activity/list-received-events-for-user.description: These are events that you've received by watching repos and following users. If you are authenticated as the given user, you will see private events. Otherwise, you'll only see public events.

activity/list-received-public-events-for.label: List public events received by a user

repos/list-for-user.label: List repositories for a user
repos/list-for-user.description: Lists public repositories for the specified user. Note: For GitHub AE, this endpoint will list internal repositories for the specified user.
repos/list-for-user.hint: Lists public repositories of any user by username. For the authenticated user's own repos (including private) use 'List repositories for the authenticated user'.

billing/get-github-actions-billing-user.label: Get GitHub Actions billing for a user
billing/get-github-actions-billing-user.description: Gets the summary of the free and paid GitHub Actions minutes used.

billing/get-github-packages-billing-user.label: Get GitHub Packages billing for a user
billing/get-github-packages-billing-user.description: Gets the free and paid storage used for GitHub Packages in gigabytes.

billing/get-shared-storage-billing-user.label: Get shared storage billing for a user
billing/get-shared-storage-billing-user.description: Gets the estimated paid and estimated total storage used for GitHub Actions and GitHub Packages.

users/list-social-accounts-for-user.label: List social accounts for a user
users/list-social-accounts-for-user.description: Lists social media accounts for a user. This endpoint is accessible by anyone.

users/list-ssh-signing-keys-for-user.label: List SSH signing keys for a user
users/list-ssh-signing-keys-for-user.description: Lists the SSH signing keys for a user. This operation is accessible by anyone.

activity/list-repos-starred-by-user.label: List repositories starred by a user
activity/list-repos-starred-by-user.description: Lists repositories a user has starred.

activity/list-repos-watched-by-user.label: List repositories watched by a user
activity/list-repos-watched-by-user.description: Lists repositories a user is watching.

meta/get-all-versions.label: Get all API versions
meta/get-all-versions.description: Get all supported GitHub API versions.

meta/get-zen.label: Get the Zen of GitHub
meta/get-zen.description: Get a random sentence from the Zen of GitHub
